effect:
An ordinary leek. Sell low.

Leek increases Farfetch'd's critical hit rate when held and it is the item it is sometimes found holding in the wild. Combined with high-crit moves like Slash, you can get more often crits!

This is Farfetch'd's signature item and honestly a need if you have one. Wild Farfetch'd only have a Leek about 5% of the time, so you may not find it right away. But again, if you're running Farfetch'd on your team, this item is basically mandatory.
